typical_causes: Low account balance at time of debit attempt. Common near end of month or before salary credit.
recommended_resolution: Retry after 24-48h aligned with likely salary/credit cycle. Send low-balance reminder nudging customer to top up before next retry.
compliance_notes: Max 3 retries per RBI auto-debit mandate rules. Minimum 24h gap required between retries.

typical_causes: Issuing bank declined transaction - could be risk flag, daily limit exceeded, or technical block on bank side.
recommended_resolution: Retry once after 12-24h. If second decline, prompt customer to try alternate payment method (UPI/different card).
compliance_notes: Do not retry more than 2 times without customer re-authorization for card transactions.

typical_causes: Saved card has passed its expiry date.
recommended_resolution: No retry possible on same card. Send reminder asking customer to update card details via secure link.
compliance_notes: Never attempt auto-retry on expired card - will always fail and may trigger issuer fraud flags.

typical_causes: Bank/issuer system did not respond within gateway timeout window - often transient infra issue.
recommended_resolution: Safe to retry within 1-6h, high chance of success since root cause is transient.
compliance_notes: Standard retry rules apply, max 3 attempts, 24h spacing.

typical_causes: Customer did not enter OTP in time - distraction, delivery delay, or network issue.
recommended_resolution: Send immediate checkout-recovery nudge (SMS/WhatsApp) with direct resume-checkout link, within 15-30 min window.
compliance_notes: No payment retry involved (checkout never completed) - only communication, no auto-debit.

typical_causes: Customer exited checkout flow voluntarily - price hesitation, comparison shopping, or distraction.
recommended_resolution: Send reminder with cart summary after 1-2h. Consider small incentive (discount code) if high-value cart.
compliance_notes: Respect do_not_contact flag strictly. Max 2 nudges before stopping.

typical_causes: Payment gateway did not respond in time during checkout - technical/infra issue, not customer intent.
recommended_resolution: Send apologetic recovery message acknowledging technical issue, direct link to retry checkout immediately.
compliance_notes: No retry limit concern since no debit occurred - communication only.

typical_causes: E-mandate/NACH mandate expired or was revoked, blocking recurring auto-debit.
recommended_resolution: Cannot auto-retry. Send mandate-renewal link requiring fresh customer authorization.
compliance_notes: RBI mandate rules require explicit re-authorization - no silent retry permitted.

typical_causes: B2B invoice past due date - could be cash flow delay, dispute, or oversight on payer side.
recommended_resolution: Escalate by days_overdue tier: 1-15d friendly reminder, 16-45d formal follow-up + call, 46-90d escalate to human/collections with promise-to-pay tracking.
compliance_notes: Tone must stay professional/non-harassing at all tiers. Escalate to human beyond 45 days overdue or high-value accounts.
